notes.title: UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello players, it is with immense satisfaction that we bring you the Brazilian Portuguese translation.

To access the subtitle settings, just go to the main menu and select "OPTIONS".

We hope that with this update your immersive experience with the game will be enhanced.

We are constantly working on improvements and updates to the game, we count on your help and support to help us make the game even better.

We hope you enjoy this little update, that your hours of play will be more fun, a big hug and good game!

notes.title: Launch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39005269/429d9320680f6fd2eb344544d969724764d68957.png[/img]
Hello, we have news!
We are developing a new game for you and your page is now available.
Add it to your wish list and don't miss the launch!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1600280/Cute_Animals_Memory_Card_Game/?beta=0

notes.title: ATTENTION!
notes.content:
Hello players!
We inform you that we are working on the translation of the game subtitles.
We are currently translating into Brazilian Portuguese and seeking help translating into the following languages: Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Russian and German.
With the help of people fluent in these languages we will have a translation with the greatest possible fidelity, if you are interested in helping us send an email with the subject: Translation, to: yumegamestudio@gmail.com.
A hug to all and good game!

notes.title: UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39005269/d0122867122628b0e14b41638389b03d21c4436d.png[/img]

1 - Created an option for volume control.
2 - Created an option to inform the game controls.
3 - Created the option to skip the cutscenes of all game modes.
4 - New game form added to Like a master mode, allowing you to select whether you want to play with a time limit or not.
5 - New achievement added when completing as a master mode playing with time limit.
6 - Code optimization to improve game performance.

Wait, new updates coming soon!

notes.title: Wait for news!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39005269/77ac4aa08c0504e843a2268f2b6c0d2839dcfb40.png[/img]

Hello players.

I come to inform you that we are working on some improvements for the game.

We would like to count on your help and suggestions so that we can make the game even better.

Comment on the community center which improvements you would like to see in the future and wait for this first update.

Soon we will bring news!
